'''Polkamon''' is one of the ending themes for the English [[dub]] of ''[[M02|The Power of One]]''. It is featured on the film's [[Pokémon the Movie 2000 (soundtrack)|soundtrack]] and is performed by {{wp|"Weird Al" Yankovic}}.

==Trivia==
* {{p|Ditto}} is listed twice, probably a reference to its name and characteristics.
** Both times it is on the third line, as the second one named.
* The song states that there are "at least 127 more" Pokémon. This is because the number 27 is a running gag within Weird Al's songs.<ref>[http://weirdal.0catch.com/txt/27.list.html We've Got It All On UHF - The 27 List]</ref> Since this song was released during [[Generation II]], this is actually accurate, since there are 210 remaining Pokémon between Generations I and II that aren't listed in the first two verses and the bridge (and 196 more that aren't listed in the song as a whole).
* When ''[[M02|The Power of One]]'' is aired in syndication, this is the only ending theme.
* In 2017, Weird Al tried to include the song on ''Medium Rarities'', an exclusive bonus disc consisting of singles and other rare tracks, as part of his compilation box set ''Squeeze Box: The Complete Works of "Weird Al" Yankovic'', but he was denied permission,<ref>[https://theseconddisc.com/2017/03/16/update-mandatory-fun-more-details-emerge-about-weird-al-yankovics-career-spanning-squeeze-box-and-medium-rarities-bonus-disc/ UPDATE! Mandatory Fun: More Details Emerge About “Weird Al” Yankovic’s Career-Spanning “Squeeze Box” and “Medium Rarities” Bonus Disc]</ref> allegedly due to Pokémon's recent rise in popularity resulting from the [[Pokémon 20th Anniversary|20th anniversary events]] and ''[[Pokémon GO]]''.<ref>[https://www.weirdalforum.com/viewtopic.php?f=73&t=12548&start=20 Medium Rarities on World of Weirld Al Yankovic forums]</ref>
